question.question: What permits or prevents entering an Escape Pod, what must you resolve first, how many Characters and Heavy Objects fit, and what are the options and consequences when you wait?

answer_key_entry.expected_answer: Use corresponding Evacuation Room Action cost 2, unlocked Pod with free space, no Intruder/Malfunction. Roll Noise first and fail if Intruder reaches Room. Two Character spaces; Heavy Objects use none. Enter then launch immediately or wait and pass current turn. At start of first round next Player Phase choose wait/pass, launch, or free exit followed by a full two-Action round. Intruder appearing in Section returns all Pod occupants; another boarder may immediately launch.
answer_key_entry.source_correction: Current official FAQ supersedes/clarifies original manual wording; source expansion explicitly versioned.

requested_parts: Conditions permitting entry into an Escape Pod and conditions preventing entry
What must happen during the entry attempt before boarding succeeds
Choices and consequences at the start of later Player Phases while waiting
a.answer: 1. Entry requires an Unlocked Pod with a free Character space in the corresponding Evacuation Section; no entry is permitted while that Section contains an Intruder or Malfunction. Pay 2 Action cards for the Section Room Action. 2. Roll Noise; if an Intruder appears or is present in the Section, entry fails. 3. A Pod holds 2 Characters; Heavy Objects use no Character space. 4. After boarding, you pass the current turn and remain treated as present in the Section for Noise rolls from bag development. At the start of your first round in each later Player Phase, choose exactly one: remain waiting and pass, launch, or exit free into the corresponding Section Room and play a full round of 2 Actions.
a.evidence: [1–2] Escape Pod Board: “pay 2 Action cards for the corresponding Evacuation Section A/B Room Action. A Pod there must be Unlocked with a free Character space. No entry while the Section contains an Intruder or Malfunction. First roll Noise; an Intruder appearing or reaching the Section makes entry fail.” [3] Capacity: “2 Characters per Pod. Heavy Objects take no Character space.” [4] Wait after boarding: “you pass the current turn. You remain treated as present in the Section for Noise rolls from bag development (FAQ Rules 1).” Later rounds: “At the start of your first round in each later Player Phase | Choose exactly one: remain waiting and pass; launch; or exit free into the corresponding Section Room and play a full round of 2 Actions (FAQ Rules 2).”

requested_parts: What Pod conditions permit or prevent boarding and the Action cost/location.
What must be resolved before boarding and when the attempt fails.
Pod capacity and whether Heavy Objects use a space.
What a boarded Character may do while waiting and the consequences of those options.
b.answer: 1. To enter a Pod, use the Evacuation Section A/B Room Action in the matching Section; pay 2 Action cards, be in that Room, be outside Combat with no Malfunction there, and choose an Unlocked Pod with a free Character space. No entry is allowed while the Section has an Intruder or Malfunction. 2. First roll Noise; if an Intruder appears or is present in the Section Room, the attempt fails; otherwise board. 3. Each Pod holds 2 Characters; Heavy Objects do not take Character spaces. 4. After boarding you may launch immediately: remove Pod and occupants' miniatures from game; they stop participating and count as arriving on Earth, but still face Contamination and Objective checks. If you wait, you pass the current turn and remain treated as present in the Section for bag-development Noise rolls. On your first round of each later Player Phase, choose exactly one: remain waiting and pass, launch, or exit free to the Section Room and play a full round of 2 Actions.
b.evidence: 1–2. Evacuation Section A/B Room Action says: “try to enter an Unlocked Escape Pod with space in that Section: make a Noise roll; if any Intruder appears (or is present) in this Room, the attempt fails; otherwise board the Pod (2 spaces per Pod).” Escape Pod rules say: “Board: pay 2 Action cards for the corresponding Evacuation Section A/B Room Action. A Pod there must be Unlocked with a free Character space. No entry while the Section contains an Intruder or Malfunction. First roll Noise; an Intruder appearing or reaching the Section makes entry fail.” Common requirements: “your Character must be in the Room whose Action you use, outside Combat, and the Room must have no Malfunction marker. Pay 2 Action cards.” 3–4. Escape Pod rules state: “Capacity: 2 Characters per Pod. Heavy Objects take no Character space.” “Launch immediately: after boarding you may launch. Remove the Pod token and its occupants' miniatures from the game; they stop participating and count as arriving on Earth. They still face the final Contamination and Objective checks.” “Wait after boarding: you pass the current turn. You remain treated as present in the Section for Noise rolls from bag development (FAQ Rules 1).” Waiting options: “Start of your first round in each later Player Phase | Choose exactly one: remain waiting and pass; launch; or exit free into the corresponding Section Room and play a full round of 2 Actions (FAQ Rules 2).”
